entries.jp: ゴードン\n
entries.en: Gordon
".......Who's there? Somebody there?
entries.speaker: ゴードン\n

entries.jp: 誰かそこにいるのか？\f

entries.en: ...... ......You... It's you, talkin' to me!"

entries.jp: おれに話しかけるお前は！」\f
entries.speaker: ・・・・・・お前は・・・\n

entries.jp: ゴードン\n
entries.en: Gordon

entries.jp: 「おれは・・・最後まで・・・\n
entries.en: "Right to the end... I never could beat ya...
entries.speaker: ゴードン\n

entries.jp: てめえには勝てなかったな・・・\f
けどよ・・・\n
entries.en: But ya know... right now, somehow, I feel strangely at peace.

entries.jp: 今は、なぜか、\n
entries.speaker: けどよ・・・\n

entries.jp: 不思議と満ち足りた気分なんだ。\f
entries.speaker: 今は、なぜか、\n

entries.jp: これで、やっと死ねる・・・\f
entries.en: Now I can finally die...

entries.jp: カイエス・・・\f
entries.en: Caius...

entries.jp: ありがとうよ・・・」\f
entries.en: Thanks..."

entries.jp: メルフィナ\n
entries.en: Melfina

entries.jp: 「え～ん、え～ん」\f
entries.en: "Waaah, waaah!"
entries.speaker: メルフィナ\n

entries.jp: シノブ\n
entries.en: Shinobu

entries.jp: 「・・・！　生きてる！\n
entries.en: "...! She's alive! This girl's alive!"
entries.speaker: シノブ\n

entries.jp: この子、生きてるわ！」\f
カイエス\n
entries.en: Caius

entries.jp: 「信じられん・・・\n
entries.en: "Unbelievable... Not even the strongest men survived. Why only this little girl?"
entries.speaker: カイエス\n

entries.jp: 屈強な男たちさえ助からなかったのに、\n
なぜ、こんな女の子だけが？」\f
シノブ\n
entries.en: Shinobu
"...... Anyway, let's take her and get out of here!"
entries.speaker: シノブ\n

entries.jp: ともかく、この子を連れて、\n
ここを出ようよ！」\f
entries.speaker: ともかく、この子を連れて、\n

entries.jp: カイエス\n
entries.en: Caius

entries.jp: 「そうだな。\n
entries.en: "Right. Let's get somewhere safe for now."
entries.speaker: カイエス\n

entries.jp: ひとまず、安全な場所へ行こう」\f
「逃がさぬ・・・」\f
entries.en: "You shall not escape..."

entries.jp: 「逃がさぬぞ・・・」\f
entries.en: "You shall not escape, I say..."

entries.jp: 「なぜ、お前らだけ、生きてるのだ？」\f
entries.en: "Why are you the only ones alive?"

entries.jp: 「憎い・・・生きてる奴が憎い・・・」\f
entries.en: "I hate them... I hate the living..."

entries.jp: 「ここを出て行きたくば、\n
entries.en: "If you want out of here, die first, then go!"

entries.jp: 死んでから行けえ！」\f
グラウベン\n
entries.en: Glauben
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「暗いぞ・・・こんなにも暗い・・・\n
entries.en: "Dark... So very dark... Why must I, a noble... be in a place like this..."
entries.speaker: グラウベン
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: なぜ、貴族のわしが・・・\n
こんなとこに・・・」\f
entries.speaker: なぜ、貴族のわしが・・・

entries.jp: マルダー\n
entries.en: Malder
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「新天地が・・・\n
entries.en: "The new land... Our new land......"
entries.speaker: マルダー
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 我らの新天地が・・・・・・」\f
ダンカン\n
entries.en: Duncan
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「財宝はどこじゃ・・・わしの・・・\n
entries.en: "Where's my treasure... My... my treasure... where is it......"
entries.speaker: ダンカン
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: わしの財宝は・・・\n
老学者\n
entries.en: Old Scholar
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「この老骨の知恵も役に立たなんだ\n
entries.en: "All my old wisdom was no use... How fearsome... the Black Dragon..."
entries.speaker: 老学者
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 恐るべきは・・・黒竜・・・・・・」\f
entries.speaker: わ・・・

entries.jp: ゲンハス\n
entries.en: Genhas
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「餌になれ・・・お前らみんな黒竜の餌\n
entries.en: "Be its food... All of you, be food for the Black Dragon...
entries.speaker: ゲンハス
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: になれ・・・\f
わしらだけが死ぬのは・・・\n
entries.en: I won't let us... be the only ones to die......"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.speaker: わしらだけが死ぬのは・・・

entries.jp: ユーバウム\n
entries.en: Yubaum
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「夢だ・・・これは悪い夢だ・・・\f
entries.en: "A dream... This is a bad dream...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 我らは貴き血を引く貴族・・・\n
entries.en: We are nobles of exalted blood... We alone are forever undefiled... How could this come to pass?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 我らこそは永遠にけがれざる者・・・\n
いかにして、このようなことが、\n
起こり得ようか。\f
・・・そうだ。\n
entries.en: ...Yes. If only the dawn would come...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 夜が明けさえすればいい・・・\f
entries.speaker: ・・・そうだ。

entries.jp: それで、この悪夢は消え去る。\n
entries.en: Then this nightmare would vanish. All would turn to illusion...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 全ては幻と化す・・・\f
だが、どうして・・・？\f
entries.en: But why...?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: いつまでたっても光が訪れぬ？\n
entries.en: Why does the light never come? Why will the deep darkness not depart?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 深き暗闇が去らぬのは、なぜだ？\f
おお、おおおおおおお・・・\n
entries.en: Oh, ohhhhhh... Someone... someone do something... Bring me light... Fetch me light..."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 誰か・・・誰か何とかしろ・・・\n
entries.speaker: おお、おおおおおおお・・・

entries.jp: わしに光を・・・\n
光を持ってまいれ・・・」\f
entries.speaker: わしに光を・・・

entries.jp: 「わしに光を・・・\n
entries.en: "Bring me light... Fetch me light..."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 光を持ってまいれ・・・」\f
遺骸は一冊の本を握りしめていた。\f
entries.en: The remains clutched a single book.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 禁書『黒竜信仰と古代文明の遺産』\f
entries.en: Forbidden book: 'Black Dragon Worship and the Legacy of Ancient Civilization'
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 読みますか？
entries.en: Read it?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: クライツェンに残る古代人の遺構は\n
entries.en: The ancient structures that remain in Kreutzen are classified as follows.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 以下のごとく分類される。\f
《谷間の遺跡》《マッカロックの遺跡》\n
entries.en: The four ruins: the Valley Ruins, the Maccaloc Ruins, the Lake Ruins and the Black Dragon Cave Ruins.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 《湖の遺跡》《黒竜洞の遺跡》\n
の、４つの遺跡。\f
entries.speaker: 《湖の遺跡》《黒竜洞の遺跡》

entries.jp: 《貴族の塔》《森の島》\n
entries.en: The two holy sites: the Nobles' Tower and Forest Island.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: の、２つの聖地。\f
entries.speaker: 《貴族の塔》《森の島》

entries.jp: 《バルクルーサ》《ザルド》\n
entries.en: The two ancient cities: Balkrutha and Zald.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: の、２つの古代都市。\f
entries.speaker: 《バルクルーサ》《ザルド》

entries.jp: これら遺構の、相互の位置関係やそれぞ\n
entries.en: Their positions relative to one another, and their individual roles, were all built with a single will: to seal the sleeping Black Dragon.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: れの役割は、全て眠れる《黒竜》を封印\n
する意志の元に造られている。\f
その個々の役割を、発掘された石盤など\n
entries.en: I wish to explore each one's role through the ancient script on excavated stone tablets and the like...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: の古代文字から探ってみたい・・・\f
おおまかに定義すれば、４つの遺跡は大\n
entries.en: Broadly defined, the four ruins serve as guardians of the land, and Forest Island as the guardian of the sea.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 地の守りを、《森の島》は海の守りを受\n
け持つものである。\f
《黒竜》の存在は、たとえそれが眠って\n
entries.en: Even asleep, the Black Dragon's mere existence exerts various influences on its surroundings.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: いても、存在するというだけで、様々な\n
影響を周囲に及ぼす。\f
微弱な波動の流出、魔物の跳梁などの現\n
entries.en: The guardians of land and sea were presumably placed to suppress such phenomena as faint leaks of the Wave and rampaging monsters.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 象を押さえるため、大地と海の守りを置\n
いたのであろう。\f
ただし、《森の島》にあったと思われる\n
entries.en: However, the structure believed to have stood on Forest Island is already lost, and at present one cannot wholly dispel unease over the safety of the sea.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 遺構はすでに失われており、現在、海の\n
安全性においては、一抹の不安を拭い得\n
ない。\f
中略\f
entries.en: (Passage omitted)
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 《黒竜》の眠りを守るための封印は\n
entries.en: The seals that guard the Black Dragon's slumber number three...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ひとつは黒竜洞にある《封印の門》と呼\n
entries.en: One is a giant black crystal in the Black Dragon Cave, called the Gate of Seals. Another is the stone tablet atop the Nobles' Tower.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ばれる巨大な黒水晶。\n
ひとつは《貴族の塔》の屋上にある石盤。\f
entries.speaker: ばれる巨大な黒水晶。

entries.jp: だが、第三の封印に関しては、古代人は\n
entries.en: Of the Third Seal, however, the ancients say nothing at all.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 何ら語っていない。\f
あらゆる古文書、石盤を調査したが、\n
entries.en: I have studied every ancient text and stone tablet, but as yet have found no clue.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 現在のところ手掛かりになるような\n
ものは未発見である。\f
中略\f
entries.en: (Passage omitted)
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ２つの古代都市の調査は完全に行き詰\n
entries.en: The survey of the two ancient cities has come to a complete standstill.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: まっている。\f
古代バルクルーサは跡形も無く消失し、\n
entries.en: For ancient Balkrutha has vanished without a trace, and as for Zald, no one has even reached it.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ザルドに至っては、誰も、たどり着くこ\n
とさえできないからだ。\f
ただ、推測するに・・・\f
entries.en: Still, if I may conjecture...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 古代バルクルーサが高所に建造された\n
entries.en: That ancient Balkrutha was built on high ground was, without doubt, a measure against the Black Dragon's Wave. And that Zald is said to lie deep within the Black Dragon Cave
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: のは、黒竜の波動対策であるのは間違\n
いなく、また、ザルドが黒竜洞の深く\f
にあるとされるのは、黒竜の寝所を守る\n
entries.en: suggests it may be seen as the last line of defense, guarding the Black Dragon's lair.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 最終防衛機構の役を担ってると見ていい\n
だろう。\f
一部の古文書の語るところでは、この地\n
entries.en: Certain ancient texts say that in this underground city lie the remains of those who built the four ruins and the seals, guarding various ancient treasures...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 下都市には、４つの遺跡や封印を造りあ\n
げた者たちの遺骸が眠り、様々な古代の\n
秘宝を守護してるという・・・\f
